title: Feedback on CLIN Structure for Design-Build Construction Projects with Capital Asset Identification and Financial Tracking

files.name: Industry Survey Capital Asset Identification Financial Tracking Design-Build_USCG final.docx

description:
The Coast Guard is considering whether future design-build construction projects could be structured to better support capital asset identification and financial tracking during project execution. This request is for market research and planning purposes only. It is not a Request for Proposal, solicitation, or commitment to issue a future contract. The Coast Guard is not requesting pricing, proposals, or offers. We are asking for industry’s practical input on what would be clear, manageable, and efficient from a contractor’s perspective. 

 Please see the attached  Industry Survey  for further information. 

 All survey responses shall be submitted to Melissa Ardis at melissa.m.ardis@uscg.mil no later than 12/16/26 at 5PM EST.
